digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria vocabulary and heading standardization
propositions: Two semantically identical criterion concepts (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) exist in rebar's plan vocabulary but all gates apply a single uniform bar, making the split vestigial and actively harmful

Criteria written under Success Criteria heading are plain bullets and do not count toward P1 blocking floor, cannot carry operator-attestation tags, and are not individually checkable, while Acceptance Criteria use checkboxes

The collapse of Success Criteria into Acceptance Criteria vocabulary must span detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing, documentation, generated guides, eval specs, test corpus, and 106 store tickets

Four live source files must retain Success Criteria terminology as carve-outs (plan_review_T2.md for experiment metrics, plan_review_verifier and verifier_agentic for dod_uncertifiable concept, verify_models.py field documentation) and cannot be changed

Store migration is complete: 106 tickets migrated from Success Criteria headings to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, zero legacy headings remain, and 8 remaining string matches are backticked prose references that are correctly untouched
The epic's acceptance criteria were amended mid-implementation to fix contradictions with its own Scope and child-story exclusions, requiring fresh plan-review attestation before close
